brief: Aggressive, high-contrast branding — near-black bands with an electric emerald that pops. Owner-forward, portfolio-heavy.

brand_derivation.source: Client's live Wix site runs a bright green (#10E698 family) on black. That signal was kept and split across the three accent jobs; the near-black primary comes from the same site. The BBB-listed blue/silver logo raster was NOT used — it is low resolution and contains a typo ('TRC - Home Improvents').
brand_derivation.logo: New typographic wordmark authored for this site: public/logo.svg (2x2 tile-grid mark + Archivo 900 wordmark). Favicon: public/favicon.svg.

anti_patterns_enforced: No stock 'handshake' or 'team pointing at a laptop' photography — every project image is the client's own work
No 'Trusted by N customers' without a sourced number
